props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.description: What the steppers and arrow keys add; Shift multiplies by 10.

components.name: Rating
components.description: A row of stars scoring out of `max`; `readOnly` only displays.

keys: Tab through the stars; Enter, Space: rate

components.macro: Expands to natives (see catalog/macros.json); the theme styles its parts by recipe Rating/<part>.

components.name: Select
components.description: A dropdown picker of one or many options; `searchable` makes it a filtering combobox, `source` a host list.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

props.name: options
props.description: Inline choices, or a path the host refills on `search`; omit with `source`.

props.name: source
props.description: A host list id (e.g. `exp:statuses`) that supplies the options.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value (comma-joined when multiple); bind it.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Adds a filter field; typing fires `search`.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when the search matches nothing.

keys: Enter, Space, ArrowDown: open on the selected option
ArrowDown/ArrowUp: move the active option; Home/End: first/last
Enter: choose (multiple: toggle and stay open)
Escape: close without change
Typing: jump to the next matching option; with `searchable`, typing filters, focus stays in the search field and arrows move the active option (aria-activedescendant)

components.name: ChipInput
components.description: A multi-value field of removable chips (Enter or comma adds); bind `values`.

props.name: name
props.description: The field's key in the submitted data.

accessibility.notes: textbox with a list of removable chips
keys: Enter or comma: add the typed entry
Backspace in an empty field: focus the last chip, again: remove it
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: move between chips; Delete, Backspace: remove the focused chip
ArrowDown: open the suggestions (as Select)
